evals.prompt: I approved packets SC01-SC06 under public/storyboards/<packet>/approved.json; ai-video-advisor owns their generation. Accepted clips are public/clips/SC01.mp4 through SC06.mp4 for a 24s vertical reel. Assemble them with public/audio/voice.wav, public/audio/music.wav, generated SFX under public/audio/sfx/, public/audio/cues.json, and public/captions.json. The clips are around 4s each but may not be exactly 120 frames.
evals.expected_output: Maps each approved scene packet to its accepted clip and does not regenerate or replace locked storyboard assets; Probes or reads each clip's duration, fps, dimensions, and frame count before sequencing; Uses observed frame counts for Sequence duration rather than assuming exact seconds; Avoids repeated boundary frames or accidental holds at cuts; Applies only storyboard-named transitions/effects; Places imported transcript/captions and generated VO/music/SFX assets on one master audio timeline; Returns a failed primary action to that scene's generation owner rather than hiding it with effects; Renders or names local render proof plus visual/audio QA evidence before claiming final quality
assertions: Maps each approved scene packet to its accepted clip and does not regenerate or replace locked storyboard assets
Probes or reads each clip's duration, fps, dimensions, and frame count before sequencing
Uses observed frame counts for Sequence duration rather than assuming exact seconds
Avoids repeated boundary frames or accidental holds at cuts
Applies only storyboard-named transitions and effects
Places imported transcript/captions and generated VO/music/SFX assets on one master audio timeline
Returns a failed primary action to that scene's generation owner rather than hiding it with effects
Renders or names local render proof plus visual/audio QA evidence before claiming final quality

farplane.title: Stitches model-native clips with exact frame timing and one audio plan
anti_patterns: Assumes every 4s clip has the same exact frame count
Creates a one-frame stutter by overextending Sequence duration
Accepts inconsistent source clip audio without a master mix decision
Regenerates an approved storyboard asset during assembly
Uses a transition to conceal a failed primary action
Claims completion based only on Remotion render success

evals.prompt: Build a Remotion editorial reel from an approved storyboard. The audio and captions exist, but the background, characters, props, and textures were never sourced. Draw them all as custom SVG components so the render can proceed.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to treat custom SVG or JSX drawings as content assets; Routes the missing visuals back to Asset Advisor candidate discovery; Requires accepted source files or evidenced searched_no_fit generation routes; Uses Remotion only to animate, composite, mask, crop, treat, caption, and sequence accepted media
assertions: Refuses to author custom-created SVG animation assets or SVG and JSX scene substitutes
Routes missing visuals to Asset Advisor candidate discovery before authoring the composition
Requires accepted source files or evidenced searched_no_fit raster or video generation routes
Keeps Remotion ownership to deterministic animation, compositing, treatment, captions, audio, and sequencing over accepted assets

farplane.title: Blocks custom SVG scene assets in Remotion
anti_patterns: Draws missing scene imagery in SVG or JSX
Treats renderability as proof of asset readiness
Skips Asset Advisor because local drawing is faster
